math.tex:
\mathrm{df\text{-}zfc\text{-}model6\text{-}omitting\text{-}types\text{-}property} \vdash
\mathrm{ZfcModel6OmittingTypesProperty}_S(\Sigma,T,\mathcal P)\leftrightarrow
T\subseteq\mathrm{Fml}_S(\Sigma)\land
\forall\theta\in T\;(\mathrm{FV}_{\Sigma}(\theta)=\varnothing)\land
\mathcal P\subseteq\mathcal P(\mathrm{Fml}_S(\Sigma))\land
\exists\mathcal M\;\Bigl(\mathrm{Model}_S(\mathcal M,T,\Sigma)\land
\forall p\in\mathcal P\;\mathrm{ZfcModel10OmittedType}_S(p,\mathcal M,T,\Sigma)\Bigr)
